release_policy.note: This is a normative requirements registry; it is NOT connected to P05 runtime until the engineer implements and tests its actual production-stage enforcer.

gates.required_proof: Verified source ledger, F/R/M/H/X modes, model card, payoff proof
gates.negative_control: Remove citation or use fictional outcome as real fact

gates.required_proof: Value Blueprint, meaningful acts, 12-part shot direction, audio-first animatic, human review
gates.negative_control: Delete causal clue or main character decision

gates.required_proof: Every approved direction/action ID maps to real supported producer and observable visual or audio outcome
gates.negative_control: Remove actual motion consumer but keep director JSON

gates.required_proof: All reachable poses, views, expressions, eyes, mouths, hand states, masks, lighting, underpaint, world/camera planes have ArtJobs
gates.negative_control: Demand complex grip but remove required fingers-underpaint cel

gates.required_proof: Actual current F01-F80 skill and authorized witnesses, method→request→approved image review, real PNG bytes
gates.negative_control: Use nonexistent witness or generic style label instead

gates.required_proof: Approved master and source-attached derived views/states with human whole-look review
gates.negative_control: Use different face for profile with matching landmarks

gates.required_proof: Original bytes, hash, dimensions, alpha, crop, provenance and matching requirement id
gates.negative_control: Import flattened screenshot as transparent arm part

gates.required_proof: Reviewed pixels/landmarks, transforms, pivots, rest recomposition, seams/underpaint/near-far
gates.negative_control: Remove hidden torso area under raised arm

gates.required_proof: All required frame evaluations, joint limits, state/paint, contacts, camera and exceptions
gates.negative_control: Return 0 checked frames with no errors

gates.required_proof: Actual registered artwork moves with anticipation/gaze/weight/body timing/follow-through and human watch review
gates.negative_control: Keep flat puppet arm while root moves

gates.required_proof: HAND state, palm basis, finger near-far, full hold, weight, prop reaction, release in all required frames
gates.negative_control: Open palm in middle of grip while particles still animate

gates.required_proof: Approved alternate heads/views/cels and valid mesh/alpha/transition across motion
gates.negative_control: Rotate frontal face as fake three-quarter or fold mesh

gates.required_proof: Full painted world/crop/depth/foreground masks for all camera positions
gates.negative_control: Push camera to reveal empty world patch

gates.required_proof: Real approved mesh/rig, matching projection/world, frame aligned RGBA/depth/shadow/occlusion and visually approved performance
gates.negative_control: Shift host camera or remove foreground occluder/shadow

gates.required_proof: Model card, input provenance, equations, changing variable→actual animated result with understandable units
gates.negative_control: Change food cost but freeze displayed profit graph

gates.required_proof: Relevant actual owner/cel/pixel evidence including blur frames and every expected action interval
gates.negative_control: Freeze Mia while background and camera move

gates.required_proof: Actual measured dialogue/audio buses/cues and final mux stream verified against final MP4 SHA
gates.negative_control: Publish old mix or silent MP4

gates.required_proof: Full running video reviewed for clarity, emotion, humor, artistic beauty, acting, credible model, rights and packaging; exact signed receipt
gates.negative_control: Technically valid ugly/stiff scene marked approved without watch

gates.required_proof: Versioned sources/images/code/audio/approvals/chunks and reproducible rerun with invalidation
gates.negative_control: Change image bytes, reuse previous render proof

gates.required_proof: 8–10s accepted actual E01 segments, contiguous 90–120s proof, final film review and cost/effort ledger
gates.negative_control: Count diagnostic test MP4 as finished Mia scene
